## Uncertainty and confirmation

- UNCLEAR: [source disagreement or ambiguous completion; show both labels and claims].
- UNKNOWN: [missing owner/date/status; identify what must be supplied].
- UNAVAILABLE: [source and retrieval problem; claims it prevents you making].
- SINGLE-SOURCE: [claim and its sole independent source; copied mentions are not corroboration].
- Follow-up: [who should clarify; label any new action/owner/date as proposed until agreed].

## Review before sharing

- [ ] Reporting period, cutoff, timezone and preparation date are explicit; later updates are separate.
- [ ] Every completed outcome has supplied acceptance evidence and source IDs.
- [ ] Planned dates remain distinct from actual completion and approved changes.
- [ ] Every number, date, owner and commitment is traceable; absent facts stay UNKNOWN.
- [ ] Proposals and conditional actions are labelled; pending decisions are not approvals.
- [ ] SINGLE-SOURCE and UNCLEAR labels survive drafting; unavailable material supports no absence claim.
- [ ] Overall status has a supplied assessor and basis, or remains UNKNOWN; no inferred completion percentage.
- [ ] Sensitive material is removed as required; a human has reviewed the final report.

Retain your original notes, this report and edits together under the reporting period. Sharing is manual. This original template has no integrations or automatic delivery.
